messages:
sam: Quick sync - preparing a hardened private/on-prem rollout. Objectives: minimal provisioner RBAC, deny-by-default egress routed through kms-proxy or customer KMS, signed audit envelopes, and evidence for isolation guarantees. Any misses?

nora: +1. Add: preflight image CVE scan and SBOM verification. If keystore/connector has CVE, block canary. Also ensure metrics sidecars are allowed to prometheus scrapers.

diego: Noted a vuln: keystore-connector 0.9.1 has CVE-2025-2100 (weak auth). We'll require 0.9.4 before rollout. Roll sequence: patch connector -> deploy kms-proxy -> apply netpol in canary ns -> bind limited provisioner role -> enable signed-forwarder.

sam: Example limited role manifest we’ll create and bind in canary only (avoid in-place patch): ```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: ClusterRole
metadata:
  name: provisioner-minimal-canary
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["pods","secrets"]
  verbs: ["get","list"]
```

nora: Netpol pattern (deny-everywhere egress except kms-proxy + monitoring): ```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: deny-egress-except-kms-proxy
spec:
  podSelector: {}
  policyTypes: ["Egress"]
  egress:
  - to:
    - namespaceSelector:
        matchLabels:
          app: kms-proxy
    - ipBlock:
        cidr: 10.5.0.0/24 # prometheus/monitoring
```

diego: Audit signing modes: (A) customer KMS reachable: require mTLS and allowlist; (B) local HSM connector: bind to localhost only, no outbound; (C) offline HSM: sign envelopes locally and ship signed bundles. Ephemeral wrapping keys TTL: 7d, publish fingerprint in tenant attest.

sam: Operational controls: egress-anomaly detector that snapshots conn metadata and auto-isolates offending pod (annotate + cordon node) and creates an evidence bundle (pcap-lite + signed audit).

sec-bot: Ticket created SEC-2026-210 assigned to diego for connector upgrade and preflight gating.

nora: Rollback plan summary: remove new ClusterRoleBinding, delete netpols, revert connector image, revoke ephemeral keys, restore previous RBAC. Keep steps idempotent.

diego: Canary window tonight 02:30 UTC. Checklist: [image-scan, deploy 0.9.4, deploy kms-proxy, apply netpol to canary ns, bind provisioner-minimal-canary, enable signed-forwarder, monitor egress & signature verification 60m]. Who can be oncall?

sam: I can.

nora: I’ll watch metrics and signature verification.

sam: Thanks. I'll update the private-deploy runbook with manifests, preflight, and evidence extraction commands. Will post a short post-canal summary after the window.
